description: Weights and rules for the Mix Health technical diagnostic score. This is NOT a musical-quality judgment — it summarizes how many measurement-backed findings were raised, weighted by severity and confidence, per category. Fully editable.
overall_score_formula: weighted_average(category_scores, category_weights), rounded to nearest integer
notes: A category with zero findings scores at its base (100), not automatically 'perfect' musically.
translation combines: mono compatibility, low-frequency phase, and true-peak headroom, since these most affect how a mix holds up on different systems.
tonal combines: spectral balance findings, resonances, and harshness findings.
Scores are clipped to [category_score_floor, 100] per category.
